The dough begins with oat flour and hot water. Its identity comes from the thin sheet, the upright roll and the many open tops packed together.
ACCOMPANIMENTS Lamb / mushrooms / tomato sauce Vinegar-based dipping sauce --------------------------------- DOUGH â†’ SHEET â†’ ROLL â†’ CLUSTER
Mix the flour with boiling water. Push a small piece into a thin sheet on a smooth surface. Lift and curl it into a short hollow tube.
Stand the rolls side by side in the steamer. Their close packing makes a honeycomb-like field of open rims.
A repeated gesture becomes a shared meal. Preserve the openings; the hollow centre is the key.
